subject: expression: remove useless `HandleOverflowOnSelection` (#50279)
summary: Reviewed the diff removing `HandleOverflowOnSelection` and its last callsites in selection bool evaluation (`pkg/expression/expression.go:244`, `pkg/store/mockstore/mockcopr/executor.go:407`, `pkg/store/mockstore/unistore/cophandler/closure_exec.go:779`, `pkg/store/mockstore/unistore/cophandler/mpp_exec.go:1119`). The only possible semantic change would be swallowing `types.ErrOverflow` during `Datum.ToBool`, but `types.Datum.ToBool` (`pkg/types/datum.go:1744`) does not produce `types.ErrOverflow` on any kind path it uses here (string/bytes go through `StrToFloat` in `pkg/types/convert.go:555` which reports truncate/wrong-value; binary literal/bit go through `BinaryLiteral.ToInt` in `pkg/types/binary_literal.go:104` which reports truncate/wrong-value). So the removed overflow-only suppression was effectively dead code. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` for the touched files; no follow-up fix indicating a regression from this change.
